name: The Monopolist
description: You inherit a beverage operation and a mandate: build a dominant, profitable, internationally known soft-drink company. Beat the domestic leader FizzCorp on brand, export enough to fund the expansion, and stay profitable for two full years running.

goals.description: Reach 70 brand awareness for soft drinks in Metropolis — become the household name.
Earn $150M of export revenue in total — roughly two bottling lines selling abroad for most of the six years.
Post 24 consecutive months of positive net income — monopolists compound, they do not spike.
Grow company value to $125M — the capstone on a finished empire.
